verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I can't be separated from this love, the love of Jesus
I can't be separated
You love me so, so well

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Precious blood
The blood of the Lamb
Precious blood
Poured out for us

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
All of my days Your mercies follow me follow me
I'll never be the same cause the way You love on me, love on me
All of my days Your mercies follow me, follow me
You love me so, so well

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
You give me joy
Down deep in my soul
Down deep in my soul
Down deep in my soul
